events.title: 레스터 시티's relegation from the Premier League was confirmed just one season after promotion; 울버햄프턴 원더러스 needed to win both of their remaining games by a significant margin and hope that 맨체스터 시티 would suffer heavy defeats in both of theirs to survive, despite beating 에버턴. Leeds still needed at least a draw against Bolton to have any chance of avoiding relegation. At the top of the Premiership, 첼시 looked set for second place while 맨체스터 유나이티드 seemed certain to settle for third place, with 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 completing the top five.

Leeds lost 4–1 to Bolton (despite taking the lead) at the Reebok Stadium , effectively sealing their relegation to the soon-to-be rebranded Football League Championship (exactly three years after contesting a Champions League semi-final), joining 레스터 시티 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
AC 밀란 clinch the Italian Serie A title.
발렌시아 win the Spanish Primera División .
베르더 브레멘 win the German Bundesliga
Ajax wins the Dutch title in the Eredivisie .

Thai Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra buys a 30% stake in 리버풀 Football Club for approximately £60 million (~ USD 100 million). It is unclear whether most of the money originates from the Thai government or is the prime minister's own money. It is hoped that the purchase will assist with the development of football in Thailand. (BBC) (Guardian)
아스널 defeat 레스터 시티 2-1 in the Premier League to become the first team to go unbeaten in the top tier English league since 프레스턴 노스 엔드 in the 1888-1889 season, going 26W-12D-0L . (BBC)

아스널 complete their last game of the Premier League season with a victory, becoming the first team to go unbeaten for a whole season in the top division of English football since 프레스턴 노스 엔드 in 1889. FIFA gives the host of the 2010 Football World Cup the first Football World Cup in Africa to South Africa

아스널 completed the Premier League season unbeaten with a 2–1 win over 레스터 시티, only the third time since the formation of the Football League in 1888 that a team has gone an entire season unbeaten in the league. Joining them in next season's Champions League were 첼시, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리버풀 (occupying second, third and fourth place respectively), while fifth-placed 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 qualified for the UEFA Cup with League Cup winners 미들즈브러.
FIFA announces that the 2010 Football World Cup will be held in South Africa. (BBC)
아스널 signed Dutch winger 로빈 판 페르시 from 페예노르트 for £2.75 million.
Goalkeeper 폴 로빈슨 left relegated Leeds in a £1.5 million move to Spurs.
In football , 발렌시아 wins the UEFA Cup , defeating 마르세유 2–0. (UEFA.com)
발렌시아 defeat 마르세유 2–0 in the UEFA Cup final in Gothenburg , Sweden.
버밍엄 시티 paid a club record £6.25 million for 리버풀 striker Emile Heskey .

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 밀월 3–0 to clinch the FA Cup for the 11th time in their history. The losers had played their first-ever major cup final; however, 맨체스터 유나이티드's participation in the Champions League meant that 밀월 would be competing in the UEFA Cup next season , the first time they will have ever played in a European competition.
English Premier League football side 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 밀월 of the First Division 3–0 to win the FA Cup . (BBC)
밀월 midfielder Curtis Weston , becomes the youngest FA Cup Final player in history at 17 years 119 days, beating the 125-year-old record of James F. M. Prinsep .
맨체스터 유나이티드 win their record 11th FA Cup , defeating 밀월 3–0.
제라르 울리에 was sacked after six years as manager of 리버풀.
Football : 포르투 defeat AS AS 모나코 FC 3–0 in the final of the UEFA Champions League (BBC)
FC 포르투 defeat AS AS 모나코 3–0 in the UEFA Champions League final in Gelsenkirchen , Germany.
대런 플레처 captains Scotland to a 1–0 win over Estonia , becoming the youngest Scottish captain in 100 years (aged 20 years, 114 days).
Telford United , who reached the FA Cup fourth round in this season, were liquidated and removed from the Conference as a result. Leeds sold striker Alan Smith to rivals 맨체스터 유나이티드 for £7 million.

크리스털 팰리스, who were 19th in Division One when Iain Dowie became manager on 22 December, won promotion to the Premier League with a 1–0 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in the play-off final. Neil Shipperley scored the only goal of the game. Ironically, Dowie was a former player of both of these clubs.
